bio.text: Peter Crosby is the Democratic nominee for Utah's 2nd Congressional District in 2026, facing Republican Rep. Blake Moore.

According to his campaign website, he earned a bachelor's degree in political science in 2011 and a master's in political science in 2013, both from Utah State University, and worked in higher education institutional research for eight years.
He is an adjunct professor at Utah State University and works in the private sector as a director, project manager and consultant, according to his campaign website.
His campaign says he and his wife have raised their three daughters in northern Utah for 19 years.
